name: Morvogodine
description: Morvogodine was a planet crawling with life that was located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Galactic Empire occupied Morvogodine during the Galactic Civil War and hosted a notoriously vicious stormtrooper training facility on the planet. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the Empire arrested famous musician Maxa Jandovar on Morvogodine to suppress her politically outspoken artistic endeavors.
